title: With Cache Components, a synchronous fs read is prerendered as a predictable value
statement: With cacheComponents enabled, `fs.readFileSync` in a Server Component is classified a predictable value and its output is baked into the static shell, whereas `await readFile()` is treated as uncached data requiring `use cache` or a Suspense boundary.
notes: ⚠️ The dangerous half is that the SIMPLER call is the unsafe one. A synchronous read is the obvious way to load a small JSON artifact, and it is the one that silently freezes.
